jobs.prompt: Build the missing way to see and resolve the ticket-manager scope gate findings. Today swarm scope approve only prints 'warning: manager scope gate failed: ticket-manager-scope-gate: ticket tree has blocking errors; 21 finding(s) need the owner' and no command lists them. (1) Add swarm scope gate --list [--json]: runs checkTicketManagerScopeIntegrity (tools/managers/ticket-manager/scope-integrity.mjs) with the same inputs approve uses (the ledger, the scope snapshot, contextEnvFor and the profile) and prints every finding grouped by severity (needs_you first): code, ticket, reason, recommendation, with the totals line; --json prints the array; exit 0. Add it to the scope usage text and the completion/command meta the same way other scope subcommands are registered. (2) In approve, when the manager gate has needs_you findings, print up to 25 of them as lines ('finding: <code> <ticket> <reason>') after the warning, with 'swarm scope gate --list shows all'. (3) Fix false positives in duplicateFileOwners: deduplicate claimers by ticket id (a ticket that lists a file in both files and tests, or twice, is one claimer, and one claimer is not a duplicate), and do not report a file when every pair of claimers is already ordered by dependsOn (transitively, ignoring cancelled and done tickets). (4) Add swarm scope gate --fix-owners [--yes]: for each remaining true duplicate, chain the claimers in ticket id order by adding dependsOn edges (each later claimer depends on the previous one), refuse an edge that would make a cycle (report it as still needing the owner), print what it would change without --yes, and with --yes apply it through the same logged ledger edit path other swarm tickets edits use (the ledger is sealed again, as 'swarm tickets ID --files' does). Add tests/scope-gate-list.test.mjs covering list output, the approve lines, the single-claimer false positive, the dependsOn-ordered case, and fix-owners with and without a cycle. Keep tests/scope-commands.test.mjs, tests/scope-approve-managers.test.mjs and the ticket-manager tests passing.
